lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: An array of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, arranged in a semi-regular grid with centroids maintaining consistent horizontal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating distinct grid-like nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running across the upper third of the visible flank, displaying high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are visible clustered near the ventral region and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
